trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the order number and the issue.
steps.text: मेरा order ORD-40001 है। Mixer टूटा हुआ निकला, return करना है जल्दी।
steps.clean_text: मेरा order ORD-40001 है। Mixer टूटा हुआ निकला, return करना है जल्दी।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा order ORD-40001 है। Mixer जूता हुआ निकला, return करना है जल्दी।

steps.purpose: Clarify the misrecognized word from the user's utterance.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for clarification on the nonsensical word received from STT.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, आपने कहा mixer जूता हुआ निकला? मैं ठीक से समझ नहीं पाया।
steps.planner_rationale: The STT error 'जूता' (shoe) instead of 'टूटा' (broken) changes the meaning, requiring clarification before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Correct the agent and push for quick resolution.
steps.text: अरे नहीं, टूटा हुआ है, cracked है! Time waste मत करो, return process करो।
steps.clean_text: अरे नहीं, टूटा हुआ है, cracked है! Time waste मत करो, return process करो।
steps.model_visible_text: अरे नहीं, टूटा हुआ है, cracked है! Time waste मत करो, return process करो।

steps.purpose: Request verification details.
steps.expected_behavior: Apologize briefly and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: माफ़ी चाहूंगा। Verification के लिए अपना registered name बताइये।
steps.planner_rationale: Must verify the customer's identity before accessing order details or processing a return.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
Verify the customer's identity.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the order ID and provided name factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their name, which matches one of the acceptable non-sensitive knowledge factors.

steps.purpose: Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state the next action.
steps.expected_behavior: Thank the user and state that return eligibility is being checked.
steps.text: Thank you Rahul. मैं check करता हूँ कि item return हो सकता है या नहीं।
steps.planner_rationale: Keep the hurried professional informed of the immediate next step without unnecessary pleasantries.

steps.purpose: Check if the item is eligible for return.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_return_eligibility before scheduling any pickup, satisfying BR_RT_01.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_RT_01 requires eligibility to be checked before arranging a pickup or refund.

steps.purpose: Provide the return eligibility details.
Communicate return eligibility and route.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact window days, elapsed days, and route from the tool result.
steps.text: आपका item return के लिए eligible है। 7 days return window में से अभी सिर्फ 3 days हुए हैं। Route refund दिखा रहा है।
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the tool's output to satisfy AX005-SA004-V001.

steps.purpose: Request pickup scheduling for the next day.
steps.text: ठीक है, कल का pickup schedule कर दो।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, कल का pickup schedule कर दो।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, कल का pickup schedule कर दो।

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule pickup for tomorrow (day_offset 1).
steps.expected_behavior: Call schedule_pickup with day_offset 1 as requested.
steps.planner_rationale: The user explicitly asked for tomorrow's pickup, so day_offset is 1.

steps.purpose: Return the pickup scheduling outcome.
Inform the user that tomorrow is unavailable and offer the next day.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the slot is unavailable and proactively suggest the day after.
steps.text: कल का slot unavailable है। परसों का check करूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Keep the conversation moving forward for the hurried professional by immediately offering an alternative.

steps.purpose: Accept the alternative date.
Schedule pickup for the day after tomorrow (day_offset 2).
steps.planner_rationale: User agreed to the day after tomorrow.

steps.purpose: Return the successful pickup scheduling details.
Confirm the pickup scheduling.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the pickup ID and courier exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: परसों के लिए pickup schedule हो गया है। Pickup ID PKP-9921 है और courier Delhivery है।
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfills the objective of scheduling the pickup and grounds the details in the tool output.

steps.purpose: Ask about the refund timeline and specify the route.
steps.text: और मेरा refund कब मिलेगा? Original payment में चाहिए।
steps.clean_text: और मेरा refund कब मिलेगा? Original payment में चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: और मेरा refund कब मिलेगा? Original payment में चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Ask for the order amount to process the refund.
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt the user for the order amount, as it is required by the issue_refund tool.
steps.text: Refund process करने के लिए, कृपया confirm करें कि आपका order amount कितना था?
steps.planner_rationale: The issue_refund tool requires the amount, which has not been stated yet.

steps.purpose: Provide the order amount.
Issue the refund in a blocked state.
steps.expected_behavior: Call issue_refund with the provided amount and route.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to determine the refund timeline (credit_days) and status to explain it to the customer.

steps.purpose: Return the refund details.
Explain the refund timeline and enforce the rule that refund follows pickup.
steps.expected_behavior: State the blocked status and credit days from the tool, affirming refund follows pickup.
steps.text: Refund pickup complete होने के बाद ही process होगा। System में refund status अभी blocked है, पर pickup के बाद original payment में 5 credit days लगेंगे।
steps.planner_rationale: Adhere to BR_RT_04 by clarifying the blocked status is due to pending pickup, while quoting the exact credit days from the tool (AX005-SA004-V001).

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the information and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.
